name: Aluminum cantilever teaching rig
goal: A benchtop apparatus demonstrates static bending. A hanger applies a transverse weight to a clamped aluminum beam. A movable dial gauge reads vertical movement.
success_criteria: Report displacement in millimetres for each arrangement. This teaching experiment specifies no allowable deflection or safety rating.
task: Students set up a hanger and dial gauge on this aluminum beam. Which changes to how they use the apparatus could affect the measured displacement? Compare with the single weight at the free end.
